decisions_this_run: Windowed only the reporting path. list_for_agent keeps limit=None = whole history because the tool gateway needs every live approval to authorise a sensitive action; paging that read would trade a reporting defect for an enforcement one. meta.total is a COUNT over the same filtered set as the page, not len(items) - the auditor's signal that an answer is complete.
limit is bounded ge=1, le=200 so a caller cannot reopen the unbounded read by asking.
